fix_code:
def process_input_and_find_max_min_deliciousness():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().strip().split('\n')
    
    N = int(data[0])
    beans = [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in data[1:N+1]]
    
    from collections import defaultdict
    color_groups = defaultdict(list)
    
    for deliciousness, color in beans:
        color_groups[color].append(deliciousness)
    
    max_min_deliciousness = float('-inf')
    
    for color in color_groups:
        min_deliciousness = min(color_groups[color])
        max_min_deliciousness = max(max_min_deliciousness, min_deliciousness)
    
    print(max_min_deliciousness)
